status: Bounded source/documentation research complete; no Hyle optimization or benchmark claimed

findings.fact: The pinned migration guide removes the old TensorRT engine backend and makes PyTorch the sole execution backend; custom CUDA leaves and compilation remain distinct from the former engine-build workflow.

findings.mechanism: Cold shared-activation quantization and consumer layout
findings.fact: GatedMLP compares static gate/up scales after loading, shares quantization only when compatible, and can emit the two-input activation directly in the down-projection input dtype.
findings.Hyle: Existing shared FP8 prologue already covers part of this principle. Quark shared A should use its expert-independent quantizer once per token. Preserve actual dtype rounding, aliases and published intermediates.

findings.fact: Attention CUDA-graph metadata is preallocated at warmup; runtime graph handling separates capture/replay and actual request metadata.
findings.Hyle: Existing finite graph family and stable binding lifetime are the natural owners; no replacement executor or padding requirement follows from this review.

findings.mechanism: Shape, dtype and architecture specific kernels
findings.fact: Read unquantized SM89 linear code retains F.linear or an explicit cuBLAS wrapper. The inspected low-M/persistent specialization has SM100 conditions; the inspected CUDA-core GEMM caller requires FP8 inputs even though the kernel source instantiates BF16.
findings.Hyle: Check real hot projection geometry and mathematical eligibility under the current cold planner. Neither a callable template nor SM100 results establish a4070 BF16 benefit. F.linear does not prove the exact internal cuBLAS algorithm selected at runtime.

findings.fact: The official architecture describes launching the next GPU step while processing previous CPU results, using device-side token dependencies and accepting an additional pipelined step.
findings.Hyle: Inspect actual trace gaps and token visibility in D4; revisit GPU metadata and acceptance lengths with the actual MTP consumer in step6. Preserve stop, failure, old results and real Completion retirement.

performance_interpretation.status: Analytical explanation, not a measured ceiling
performance_interpretation.small_batch: Decode can be constrained by weight/KV/state traffic, low parallelism and launch/synchronization gaps. Fewer kernels alone is not a throughput result.
performance_interpretation.large_batch: Batching reuses weights across requests and changes arithmetic intensity; aggregate tokens/s is a different metric from one-request decode.
performance_interpretation.comparison: Same GPU, weights/quantization, input/context, batch, speculative mode and token-visible timing boundary are required. Blackwell, FP4 and high-concurrency numbers cannot certify4070 BF16 behavior.
